verdict.rationale: Draft A states FY2026 net cash ($2.1bn), a 75.5% drop in cash and investments, and a peer rank as fact. A has richer drivers (H20 charge, China, customer concentration), but grounding outweighs that.

B adds real depth on customer concentration, China and peers, yet these do not offset a misread liquidity picture.
